name: Gratitude
q: Be grateful even for a sip of water
Even free lye water, say thanks first
Repay kindness, even by tying grass
Gratitude is the parent of all virtues
Thank the small to know the great
No one writes kindness in a ledger
No wind is as unkind as ingratitude
Wise is he who rejoices in what he has
The first step in repaying a kindness is remembering it
The giver loves more than the receiver
Count what you have, not what you lack
Grateful minds owe not, yet still pay
Spread kindness; you may meet again
Gratitude is the memory of the heart
